title: Can't get past objective 1 in fresh AAPS install with NSClientV3
body:
AAPS 3.2.0.3
Build: bb1a276078-2023.12.17
Nightscout version: 15.0.2

I've seen some new users having issues with this, so I have recreated the problem. Steps:
1) Do a fresh install of AAPS
2) configure NSclientv3
3) enable all uploads etc to NS

Alltho BG is uploaded to NS, the objective regarding this doesnt get completed.

Workaround is to select NSClientV1, then objective gets completed.

Logs:
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1703899762554.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13796768/AndroidAPS_LOG_1703899762554.log.zip)

comments.body: i got the same problem how i can fix it
Switch to NSClientv1 and see that objective pass then switch back
I hit this too. The above workaround worked.
